top_violation_types.title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection, there were 11 infants in care and the total capacity for infants in the permit is 10.

top_violation_types.title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation failed to notify Licensing of a reportable illness within the required timeframe.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no documentation of fire safety emergency drills, fire extinguisher checks, smoke detector checks, and carbon monoxide detector testing made available for review during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation (26 TAC §745.621(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that the primary caregiver did not submit a background check for a household member.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 12 children did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Size of Mesh Openings (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(G))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There is a large hole on one side of the play yard measuring about 8 inches in diameter.

top_violation_types.title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Sign in and out logs were not available for review during this inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher was not mounted.
